detail.description: Once per session as an action, make a :hard: mechanics check to cause one targeted device to spontaneously fail.

detail.name: Bad Press
detail.description: Once per session as an action, may make a :hard: Deception check to reduce the Wound Thresholds of an organisations members by 1, plus 1 per :success::success::success: (to a minimum of 1), until the end of the session.

detail.name: Balance
detail.description: When the character rolls to recover Strain at the end of an encounter, they may roll {Force Rating} and recover Strain equal to :forcepip: generated.

detail.name: Barrage
detail.description: Add {ranks} damage to all Gunnery and Ranged attacks at Medium or Long range.

detail.name: Basic Combat Training
detail.description: Brawl and Ranged: Light become career skills.

detail.name: Black Market Contacts
detail.description: Decrease rarity of sought item by {ranks|words} when looking on the black market; item’s cost is increased by 50%.

detail.name: Blackmail
detail.description: When an NPC exceeds their Strain Threshold by any means other than a combat check, may spend one Destiny point to compel the NPC to perform one simple task before becoming Incapacitated.

detail.name: Blooded
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to all checks to resist or recover from venoms, poisons, and toxins; reduce duration of ongoing effects from poisons, venoms, and toxins by two rounds, to a minimum of one.

detail.name: Body Guard
detail.description: Once per round, may suffer up to {ranks} Strain to take the Body Guard maneuver to protect an engaged ally; until the end of the character’s next turn, upgrade the difficulty of all combat checks targeting the protected ally once per Strain spent.

detail.name: Body Guard (Improved)
detail.description: Once per session, when an ally protected by the character’s Body Guard maneuver would suffer a hit from a combat check, the character may choose to suffer the hit instead.

detail.name: Bought Info
detail.description: Instead of making a Knowledge check, may take a Bought Info action to spend credits equal to 50 times the difficulty of the check to pass with one :success:.

detail.name: Brace
detail.description: As a maneuver, remove up to {ranks|setback} added due to environmental conditions from next skill check.

detail.name: Brilliant Evasion
detail.description: Once per encounter when piloting a vehicle or starship, as an action may select one opponent and make an opposed Piloting: Planetary or Space check; if successful the opponent’s vehicle of starship cannot attack the character’s vehicle for {Agility} rounds.

detail.name: Burly
detail.description: Reduce any wielded or carried wepaon's Cumnbersome quality and Encumbrance rating by {ranks} to a minimum of 1.

detail.name: Bypass Security
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from any Computers or Skulduggery check to bypass security.

detail.name: Calming Aura
detail.description: When an opponent targets the character with a Force power, after the opponent generates :forcepip:, reduce the total number of :forcepip: generated by one, to a minimum of 0.

detail.name: Calming Aura (Improved)
detail.description: The character may spend a maneuver and suffer 2 Strain to extend the effects of Calming Aura to {ranks|Willpower} allies within Short range. This lasts until the beginning of the character’s next turn.

detail.name: Careful Planning
detail.description: Once per session, may introduce a “fact” into the narrative as if a Destiny Point had been spent.

detail.name: Centre of Being
detail.description: Once per round, when wielding a lightsaber, may make a Centre of Being maneuver. Until the beginning of the character’s next turn, whenever an enemy makes a melee attack targeting the character, the critical rating of the enemy’s weapon counts as {ranks|words} higher.

detail.name: Centre of Being (Improved)
detail.description: Once per round, when wielding a lightsaber, may make a Centre of Being incidental. Until the beginning of the character’s next turn, whenever an enemy makes a melee attack targeting the character, the critical rating of the enemy’s weapon counts as {ranks|words} higher.

detail.name: Circle of Shelter
detail.description: When an Engaged ally suffers a hit, may use Parry or Reflect incidental against the hit.

detail.name: Clever Commander
detail.description: When upgrading the ability of a mass combat check, may use Knowledge: Warfare in place of Leadership.

detail.name: Clever Solution
detail.description: Once per session, make one skill check using Cun­ning rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.

detail.name: Codebreaker
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from checks made to break codes or decrypt communications; decrease difficulty of checks made to break codes or decrypt commu­nications by 1.

detail.name: Command
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to Leadership checks; affected targets add {ranks|boost} to Discipline checks for the next 24 hours.

detail.name: Commanding Presence
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Leadership checks.

detail.name: Comprehend Technology
detail.description: Once per session, the character may take the Comprehend Technology Action, making an :average: Knowledge: Education skill check to intuitively understand one piece of equipment. For the remained of the encounter, when making any skill checks to use or repair the item the character may use their Force Rating in place of the skill.

detail.name: Conditioned
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from Athletics and Coordination checks. Reduce Strain suffered from falling by {Coordination}.

detail.name: Confidence
detail.description: Decrease difficulty of Discipline checks to avoid fear {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Congenial
detail.description: May suffer up to {ranks} Strain to downgrade the difficulty of Charm or Negotiation checks by one per Strain spent or upgrade difficulty once per Strain spent when targeted by Charm or Negotiation checks.

detail.name: Contingency Plan
detail.description: May spend one Destiny point to recover {Cunning} Strain.

detail.name: Contraption
detail.description: Once per session, as an action, may make a :hard: Mechanics check to fashion a device to solve a current problem using just the tools and parts on hand.

detail.name: Convincing Demeanor
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from any Deception or Skulduggery check.

detail.name: Coordinated Assault
detail.description: As a maneuver, may grant {Leadership} allies in Engaged range :advantage: to all combat checks until the beginning of next turn; increase range per rank.

detail.name: Coordination Dodge
detail.description: When targeted by a combat check, as an incidental, may spend one Destiny point to add {ranks|failure}.

detail.name: Counterstrike
detail.description: Whenever an attack misses the character, they may spend :threat::threat: or :despair: to upgrade the next Lightsaber (Cunning) combat check they make against the attacker during their next turn once.

detail.name: Creative Killer
detail.description: Reduce the critical rating of all improvised weapons the character is wielding by 2 to a minimum of 1.

detail.name: Crippling Blow
detail.description: May increase difficulty of attack by 1. If successful, target suffers 1 Strain when moving for remainder of encounter.

detail.name: Crucial Point
detail.description: Once per session during ongoing negotiations, as an incidental, may introduce one concession that an opponent will do anything to obtain.

detail.name: Cutting Question
detail.description: Once per encounter, may make one Coercion check using the Deception skill.

detail.name: Dead to Rights
detail.description: Spend 1 dark side Destiny Point to add additional damage equal to half Agility to one hit of a successful attack made with ship or vehicle-mounted weaponry.

detail.name: Dead to Rights (Improved)
detail.description: The character may spend one Destiny point to add {Agility} to one hit of a successful attack made by ship or vehicle-mounted weaponry. This replaces the normal Dead to Rights ability.

detail.name: Deadly Accuracy (Brawl)
detail.description: Add {Brawl} to all damage from attacks using Brawl.

detail.name: Deadly Accuracy (Melee)
detail.description: Add {Melee} to all damage from attacks using Melee.

detail.name: Deadly Accuracy (Ranged: Light)
detail.description: Add {Ranged: Light} to all damage from attacks using Ranged: Light.

detail.name: Deadly Accuracy (Ranged: Heavy)
detail.description: Add {Ranged: Heavy} to all damage from attacks using Ranged: Heavy.

detail.name: Death From Above
detail.description: Once per encounter while using a jetpack, may take the Death From Above action, inflicting 1 system strain on their jetpack and making a :hard: Piloting (Planetary) check. If the check is successful, for each :success:, one adversary of silhouette 0 or 1 within Short range is knocked prone. May spend :triumph: to stagger one affected target until the end of that adversary's next turn.

detail.name: Debilitating Shot
detail.description: When making a successful attack with a ship or vehicle-mounted weapon, may spend :advantage::advantage: to reduce the maximum speed of the target by 1, to a minimum of 1, until the end of the next round.

detail.name: Defensive Circle
detail.description: While wielding a lightsaber, the character may take the Defensive Circle action and make a :hard: Lightsaber (Intellect) skill check. If successful the character plus one ally per :success: within Short range gains ranged and melee defence equal to 1 plus 1 per :advantage::advantage: until the beginning of the character’s next turn.

detail.name: Defensive Driving
detail.description: Increase Defence of vehicle or starship being piloted {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Defensive Slicing
detail.description: When defending computer systems, add {ranks|setback} to opponents’ checks.

detail.name: Defensive Slicing (Improved)
detail.description: When defending computer systems, upgrade the difficulty of an opponent’s dice pool {ranks|words}.

detail.name: Defensive Stance
detail.description: Once per round on the character’s turn as a maneuver, they may suffer up to {ranks} Strain to upgrade the difficulty of all melee combat checks targeting them once per Strain spent. This lasts until the start of the character’s next turn.

detail.name: Defensive Training
detail.description: When the character wields a Lightsaber, Melee, or Brawl weapon, that weapons gains Defensive {ranks}.

detail.name: Discredit
detail.description: Once per encounter as an action, make a :hard: Deception check to make one character upgrade the difficulty of social checks once, and one additional time for every :advantage::advantage:.

detail.name: Disorient
detail.description: After hitting with a combat check, may spend :advantage::advantage: to disorient target for {ranks|words} rounds.

detail.name: Disruptive Strike
detail.description: The character may take a Disruptive Strike action, making a Lightsaber (Cunning) skill check against one Engaged target and add {Force Rating}. Spend :forcepip: to add :failure: to the target’s next combat check.

detail.name: Distracting Behaviour
detail.description: As a maneuver, may suffer up to {Cunning} Strain to make an equal number of adversaries at Engaged range suffer :threat: on their next skill check. Ranks increase range band.

detail.name: Distracting Behaviour (Improved)
detail.description: As a maneuver, may suffer up to {Cunning} Strain to make an equal number of adversaries at Engaged range suffer :threat::threat: on their next skill check. Ranks increase range band.

detail.name: Djem So Deflection
detail.description: Once per round, after using the Reflect incidental, the character may spend one Destiny point to perform Move manevuer as an out of turn incidental to move closer to or engage an opponent.

detail.name: Dodge
detail.description: Once per round, when targeted by a combat check, suffer up to {ranks} Strain to upgrade the difficulty once per Strain spent.

detail.name: Double-Talk
detail.description: May spend :advantage::advantage: or :triumph: from a successful Charm or Deception check to Disorient {Presence} opponents within Short range for the remainder of the current round and the next two rounds.

detail.name: Draw Closer
detail.description: Perform Draw Closer action; make a Lightsaber (Willpow­er) combat check against one Silhouette 1 target within Medium range, adding :force: no greater than Force rating to check. Spend :forcepip: to move target one range band closer or to add :success: to check.

detail.name: Drive Back
detail.description: Spend :triumph: or :advantage::advantage::advantage: on a missed Brawl, Lightsaber, or Melee combat check to force the target to make a move maneuver in a direc­tion of the character’s choice.

detail.name: Duelist’s Training
detail.description: Add :boost: to Melee and Lightsaber skill checks when engaged with a single opponent.

detail.name: Durable
detail.description: Subtract {ranks|multiply-10} from Critical Injury rolls made against the character.

detail.name: Dynamic Fire
detail.description: When making a ranged attack while engaged with an opponent, the character may suffer 2 Strain to reduce the ranged modifier for being engaged by 1 for the attack.

detail.name: Empty Soul
detail.description: If carrying items that total 2 Encumbrance or less, may add :lightside::darkside: to any Force power check.

detail.name: Encoded Communique
detail.description: Upgrade the difficulty of checks to decrypt this character’s coded messages without the proper cipher {Computers} times.

detail.name: Encouraging Words
detail.description: When an ally at Engaged range fails a check, may suffer 1 Strain to assist the next check that ally makes in this encounter as an out of turn incidental.

detail.name: Enduring
detail.description: Increase Soak by {ranks} (already included in profile).

detail.name: Enhanced Leader
detail.description: Add :force: equal to Force rating to Leadership checks; spend :forcepip: to add :success: or :advantage: to the result.

detail.name: Exhaust Port
detail.description: Before attacking a starship or vehicle, the character may spend one Destiny point to ignore the effects of the Massive rule for the attack.

detail.name: Expert Handler
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from Survival checks to ride beasts.

detail.name: Expert Tracker
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from checks to find tracks or track targets; decrease time to track a target by 50%.

detail.name: Eye for Detail
detail.description: When making a Mechanics or Computers check, may suffer up to {ranks} Strain to convert an equal number of :success: into :advantage:.

detail.name: Falling Avalanche
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to add {Brawn} to damage of one successful Lightsaber combat check.

detail.name: Familiar Suns
detail.description: Once per session, may spend a maneuver to make a :hard: Knowledge: Outer Rim or Knowledge: Core Worlds check to know information about the current planet.

detail.name: Fearsome
detail.description: May force Engaged opponents to make a fear check with the difficulty equal to ranks in Fearsome.

detail.name: Fear is My Ally
detail.description: Spend :threat: on an opposed social skill check against Maul for him to recover 1 Strain.

detail.name: Feint
detail.description: Upon missing an opponent with a Lightsaber, Brawl, or Melee combat check, may spend :triumph: or :advantage::advantage::advantage: to upgrade the difficulty of the opponent’s next combat check targeting this character {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Feral Strength
detail.description: +{ranks} damage on all Brawl and Melee attacks.

detail.name: Field Commander
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Leadership check; {Presence} allies may immediately suffer 1 Strain to perform a free maneuver.

detail.name: Field Commander (Improved)
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Leadership check; {Presence} allies may immediately suffer 1 Strain to perform a free maneuver; spend :triumph: to allow one ally to perform an action instead.

detail.name: Fine Tuning
detail.description: Repair an additional {ranks} System Strain when repairing ships or vehicles.

detail.name: Finesse
detail.description: May use Agility instead of Brawn for Brawl and Melee checks.

detail.name: Fire Control
detail.description: Take the Fire Control action; all combat checks made from current starship or vehicle count their target’s Silhouette as one higher than nor­mal until the beginning of next turn.

detail.name: Forager
detail.description: Remove up to :setback::setback: from skill checks to find food, water, or shelter; Suvival checks take half the time.

detail.name: Force Assault
detail.description: Upon missing an opponent with a Lightsaber (Willpower) combat check, may spend :triumph: or :advantage::advantage::advantage: to perform a Move Force power action as a maneuver this turn.

detail.name: Force of Will
detail.description: Once per session, may make one skill check using Willpower rather than the characteristic linked to the skill.

detail.name: Force Protection
detail.description: As a maneuver, May suffer 1 Strain and commit a number of :force: no greater than Force Rating or ranks of Force Protection. Increase Soak by :force: committed. Spend 1 Strain at the beginning of each turn in which :force: remain committed.

detail.name: Force Rating
detail.description: Roll {ranks|force} to activate Force powers.

detail.name: Forewarning
detail.description: As an action, may allow all allies within Medium range to increase their melee and ranged defence by {Force Rating} until they take their first turn during an encounter.

detail.name: Formation Tactics
detail.description: As an action, may make a :hard: Leadership to choose a number of allies within Short range equal to :success:. The difficulty of the attacks against the chosen allies are upgraded once until the end of the character’s next round.

detail.name: Formation Tactics (Improved)
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Leadership to choose a number of allies within Short range equal to :success:. The difficulty of the attacks against the chosen allies are upgraded once until the end of the character’s next round. Spend :triumph: or :advantage::advantage::advantage::advantage::advantage::advantage: to have the effect last until the end of the encounter.

detail.name: Form on Me
detail.description: {Leadership} allies in Close range gain the benefits of the Gain the Advantage action.

detail.name: Frenzied Attack
detail.description: When making a Melee or Brawl check, suffer up to {ranks} Strain to upgrade the attack an equal number of times.

detail.name: Full Stop
detail.description: When piloting a ship or vehicle, may take the Full Stop maneuever to immediately reduce the speed of the ship or vehicle to zero. The ship or vehicle suffers 1 System Strain for every point of speed it had before stopping.

detail.name: Full Throttle
detail.description: Take a Full Throttle action and make a :hard: Piloting (Space or Planetary) check to increase a vehicle’s top speed by 1 for {Cunning} rounds.

detail.name: Full Throttle (Improved)
detail.description: Suffer 1 Strain to make an :average: Piloting: Planetary check as maneuver and in­crease top speed by 1 for {Cunning} rounds.

detail.name: Full Throttle (Supreme)
detail.description: As an action, make a :hard: piloting check to increase the vehicle’s top speed by two for three rounds; suffer 1 Strain to use as maneuver and reduce difficulty to :average:.

detail.name: Galaxy Mapper
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Astrogation checks; Astrogation checks take 25% less time per rank.

detail.name: Gang Leader
detail.description: May spend a maneuver giving orders to other posse mem­bers within Medium range, granting them :boost: on their next check.

detail.name: Gearhead
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from Mechanics checks.

detail.name: Good Cop
detail.description: The character may spend :advantage::advantage: from a Charm or Negotiation check to upgrade the ability of a single ally’s subsequent social interaction check against the same target {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Go Without
detail.description: Once per session as an incidental, the character counts as having the right tools for the job when performing a skill check this turn.

detail.name: Grapple
detail.description: Once per round, may perform the Grapple ma­neuver. Until the beginning of the character’s next turn, en­emies must spend two maneuvers instead of one to move from Engaged range to Short range of the character.

detail.name: Greased Palms
detail.description: Before making a social check, may spend up to {ranks|multiply-50} cred­its to upgrade the ability of the check once per 50 credits spent.

detail.name: Guns Blazing
detail.description: When making a combined cmobat check with two Ranged: Light weapons, may suffer 2 Strain to ignore the difficulty penalty from attacking with two weapons.

detail.name: Hard Headed
detail.description: On any turn when Staggered or Disoriented, may perform the Hard Headed action to make a :daunting: Discipline skill check. If successful the character is no longer Staggered or Disoriented. The difficulty of this check decreases by one per rank, to a minimum of :easy:.

detail.name: Hard Headed (Improved)
detail.description: May use the Hard Headed action to recover from being Incapacitated due to exceeding Strain Threshold. On the turn after being Incapacitated the character may make a :formidable: Discipline check, if successful their Strain decreases to one below their Strain Threshold. The difficulty of this check decreases by one per rank, to a minimum of :easy:.

detail.name: Hawk Bat Swoop
detail.description: May perform a Light­saber (Agility) melee combat check against one target within Short range and add :force: no greater than Force Rating to the pool. The character may spend :forcepip: before resolving the success or failure of the check to engage the target immediately as an inci­dental, and may spend :forcepip: to add :advantage: to the check. If the character cannot move to engage the target, the attack automatically misses.

detail.name: Healing Trance
detail.description: The character may commit :force:. For every full encounter :force: remains committed, the character heals {ranks} additional Wound(s) they are suffering.

detail.name: Healing Trance (Improved)
detail.description: Whenever the character heals Wounds as a result of Healing Trance, if they are suffering from a Critical Injury, they may make a Resilience check with the difficulty equal to the Critical Injury’s severity rating. If successful, they recover from the Critical Injury.

detail.name: Heavy Hitter
detail.description: Once per session, may spend :triumph: on a successful Ranged: Heavy or Gunnery check to add the Breach 1 quality to the attack or increase an existing Breach rating by 1.

detail.name: Heightened Awareness
detail.description: Allies within Short range add :boost: to Perception and Vigilance checks; allies in Engaged range add :boost::boost: instead.

detail.name: Heroic Fortitude
detail.description: Spend one Destiny point to ignore effects of Critical Injuries on Brawn or Agility checks until the end of the encounter.

detail.name: Heroic Resilience
detail.description: Immediately after being hit by a successful combat check but before damage is calculated, may spend one Destiny point to increase Soak by {Resilience}.

detail.name: Hidden Storage
detail.description: An large equipment, vehicle, or droid the character owns has one or more hidden compartments with an encumbrance total of {ranks}.

detail.name: Hit And Run
detail.description: While the character is using a jetpack, after they complete an attack targeting an opponent they are engaged with, they may immediately disengage as an incidental.

detail.name: Hold Together
detail.description: Flip one Destiny Point to make a Hold Together incidental immediately after a starship takes damage to convert the suffered Hull Trauma to System Strain.

detail.name: Hunter
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to all skill checks when interacting with wild beasts and animals, including combat checks. Add {ranks|multiply-10} to all Criti­cal Injury rolls against animals.

detail.name: Hunter’s Quarry
detail.description: As an action make a :hard: Survival check to upgrade the ability of all attacks against one target at Long range until the end of the big game hunter’s next turn.

detail.name: Hunter’s Quarry (Improved)
detail.description: may take the Hunter’s Quarry action against an opponent within long range, making a :hard: Survival check. If the check succeeds, upgrade the ability of all attacks made against the target by one until the end of the character’s next turn. The character can choose to suffer 2 strain to perform the Hunter’s Quarry action as a maneuver instead

detail.name: Idealist
detail.description: Spend 1 Strain to add an :advantage: on a skill check.

detail.name: Imbue Item
detail.description: Spend a maneuver to com­mit :force: and grant one weapon at Short range +1 dam­age or decrease critical rating of weapon by one.

detail.name: Improved Dodge
detail.description: When the character performs the Dodge incidental, the character may make a Move maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental after the triggering attack has been resolved.

detail.name: Improvised Detonation
detail.description: Once per session as an action, may make a :hard: Mechanics check to build an explosive device out of available materials. The device's damage is equal to Intellect, plus Mechanics, plus :success: and possesses the Blast quality at an equal value. Spend :triumph: to increase the damage by 2. :despair: causes the device to detonate immediately.

detail.name: Improvised Detonation (Improved)
detail.description: Once per session as an action, may make a :average: Mechanics check to build an explosive device out of available materials. The device's damage is equal to Intellect, plus Mechanics times two, plus :success: and possesses the Blast quality at an equal value. Spend :triumph: to increase the damage by 2. :despair: causes the device to detonate immediately.

detail.name: In the Know
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} to get information from people or disseminate it to others.

detail.name: In the Know (Improved)
detail.description: Once per session as an action, may make an opposed Deception vs Vigilance check against an NPC with the difficulty downgraded {ranks|times}. The NPC believes false information created by the character.

detail.name: Incite Rebellion
detail.description: Once per session as an Action, make a :hard: Coercion check to cause up to {Coercion} beings to become rebellious until the end of the encounter.

detail.name: Indistinguishable
detail.description: Opposing characters upgrade the difficulty of any checks made to identify the character {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Informant
detail.description: Once per session, may reveal a contact who possesses information on a subject of the character's choice.

detail.name: Insight
detail.description: Perception and Discipline are career skills.

detail.name: Inspiring Leadership
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Leadership check to grant up to {Presence} allies within Short range an automatic :success: on their next skill check.

detail.name: Inspiring Rhetoric
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Leadership check; each :success: removes one Strain or Wound from one ally in Short range; spend :advantage: to remove an additional Strain or Wound from an affected ally.

detail.name: Inspiring Rhetoric (Improved)
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Leadership check; each :success: removes one Strain or Wound from one ally in Short range; spend :advantage: to remove an additional Strain or Wound from an affected ally; all affected allies add :boost: to all checks for two rounds.

detail.name: Inspiring Rhetoric (Supreme)
detail.description: As a maneuver, may make an :average: Leadership check; each :success: removes one Strain or Wound from one ally in Short range; spend :advantage: to remove an additional Strain or Wound from an affected ally; all affected allies add :boost: to all checks for four rounds.

detail.name: Intense Focus
detail.description: Suffer 1 Strain to upgrade any skill check once.

detail.name: Intense Presence
detail.description: Spend 1 dark side Destiny point to recover {Presence} Strain.

detail.name: Interjection
detail.description: After another character makes a social check, may suffer 3 Strain make an :average: Vigilance check. The character may add :success: or :failure: to the results of the chosen check equal to :successL on the Vigilance check and :advantage: or :threat: equal to :threat: on the Vigilance check.

detail.name: Intimidating
detail.description: May suffer up to {ranks} Strain to downgrade the difficulty of a Coercion check a number of times equal to the Strain suffered; when targeted by Coercion, they may suffer up to {ranks} Strain to upgrade the difficulty of the opponent’s check a number of times equal to the Strain suffered.

detail.name: Intuitive Evasion
detail.description: As a ma­neuver, suffer 1 Strain and commit :force: to upgrade the difficulty of all combat checks targeting pilot’s vehicle once, until the beginning of pilot’s next turn.

detail.name: Intuitive Improvements
detail.description: When mak­ing a check to repair or craft an item, may add :force: up to Force Rating to the check. Spend :forcepip::forcepip: to permanently increase the item’s hard points by 1.

detail.name: Intuitive Navigation
detail.description: Add :advantage: to all Astrogation checks.

detail.name: Intuitive Shot
detail.description: When making a Ranged: Heavy, or Ranged: Light combat check, may add {Force Rating} to the check. May spend :forcepip: to add :success: or :advantage: to the result.

detail.name: Intuitive Strike
detail.description: When making a combat check with a vehicle weapon, may add {Force Rating} to the check. Spend :forcepip::forcepip: to add :success: or :advantage: to the result.

detail.name: Inventor
detail.description: When constructing new items or modifying attachments, may choose to add {ranks|boost} or remove {ranks|setback} from the check.

detail.name: Invigorate
detail.description: Once per encounter, when an ally within Short range attempts a skill check using Brawn or Agility, may roll :force:. Each :lightside: adds :success: to the target’s check; while each :darkside: adds :threat:.

detail.name: Iron Soul
detail.description: If carrying items that total 2 Encumbrance or less, may heal all Strain at the end of an encounter.

detail.name: It’s Not That Bad
detail.description: Once per session, when an ally is about to suffer a Critical Injury, may take an It’s Not That Bad incidental to make a :hard: Medicine check. If successful, the ally does not gain the Critical Injury.

detail.name: Jetpack Expertise
detail.description: The character may spend :advantage: from checks they make to remove 1 system strain from a jetpack they are equipped with. (They may choose this effect multiple times when spending :advantage:).

detail.name: Jump Up
detail.description: Once per round, may stand from seated or prone as an incidental.

detail.name: Jury Rigged
detail.description: The character chooses one personal weapon or piece of armour per rank. May increase the damage of a weapon by one; decrease the critical rating by 1; or increase the range and melee defence of armour 1.

detail.name: Just Kidding!
detail.description: Once per round as an incidental, when the character or any of his allies in short range generages a :despair: on a social skill check, the character may spend one Destiny Point to convert a single :despair: generated on the check to :failure:. When he does this, he must explain what he says or does to smooth things over after the verbal misstep

detail.name: Just Kidding! (Improved)
detail.description: Once per round, spend one Destiny Point to convert a single :despair: on one social check to :advantage:, but must explain how the verbal misstep became advantageous.

detail.name: Keen Eyed
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from Perception and Vigilance checks; checks made to search a specific time take 50% less time than usual.

detail.name: Kill with Kindness
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Charm and Leadership checks.

detail.name: Knockdown
detail.description: May spend :triumph: to knock target prone with successful melee attack.

detail.name: Know Somebody
detail.description: Once per session, when attempting to purchase a legally available item, reduce its rarity by {ranks|words}.

detail.name: Know the Enemy
detail.description: May use Knowledge: Warfare when making checks for initiative.

detail.name: Know their Weakness
detail.description: Once per session, the character may choose one target within Short range and perform the Know Their Weakness action to make a :hard: Perception check. If successful, the character downgrades the difficulty of all social skill checks they make against the target once per rank of Know Their Weakness.

detail.name: Knowledge is Power
detail.description: Once per session, when making a single check, may treat Force Rating as {Knowledge: Lore}.

detail.name: Knowledge Specialization
detail.description: When acquired, choose 1 Knowledge skill. When making that skill check, may spend :triumph: result to gain {ranks|success}.

detail.name: Knowledge Specialization: Lore
detail.description: When making skill checks with Knowledge: Lore, may spend :triumph: result to gain {ranks|success}.

detail.name: Knowledgeable Healing
detail.description: When the character performs a successful Medicine check, may spend one Destiny point heal {Knowledge: Xenology} additional Wounds.

detail.name: Known Schematic
detail.description: Once per session, may perform the Known Schematic maneuver; make a :hard: Knowledge (Education) check; success grants familiarity with a building or ship’s design.

detail.name: Lead from the Back
detail.description: Once per round when an enemy makes a successful combat check targeting the character, the character may spend one Destiny point to perform the Lead from the Back incidental. The character chooses one allied NPC subordinate within Short range, who becomes the target of the attack instead. At the GM's discretion, the character may select an allied NPC at a greater distance if they are between the character and the attacker.

detail.name: Let’s Ride
detail.description: May mount or dismount from a creature as an incidental.

detail.name: Lethal Blows
detail.description: Add {ranks|multiply-10} to Critical In­jury rolls against opponents.

detail.name: Loom
detail.description: When an Engaged ally makes a successful Charm, Deception, or Negotia­tion check, add :advantage: per rank in Coercion to the check.

detail.name: Makashi Flourish
detail.description: Once per encounter, as an action action, make an :average: Lightsaber (Presence) check. If successful, one Engaged opponent suffers Strain equal to :success: and the character recovers an equal amount of Strain. May also spend :triumph: or :advantage::advantage::advantage: to Stagger the opponent until the end of their next turn.

detail.name: Makashi Technique
detail.description: May use Presence instead of Brawn when making Lightsaber skill checks.

detail.name: Martial Grace
detail.description: Once per round, may suffer 2 Strain to add {Coordination} damage to one hit of a successful Brawl combat check.

detail.name: Master Artisan
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Mechanics check by 1.

detail.name: Master Doctor
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Medicine check by 1.

detail.name: Master Driver
detail.description: Once per round when piloting a vehicle using the Piloting: Planetary skill, suffer 2 Strain to perform any action as a maneuver instead.

detail.name: Master Grenadier
detail.description: Decrease the :advantage: cost to activate the Blast quality of any weapon used by 1 to a minimum of 1.

detail.name: Master Instructor
detail.description: Once per round as an out of turn incidental, may suffer 2 strain to allow ally to use character’s ranks in Discipline for next Discipline check an ally makes.

detail.name: Master Leader
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Leadership check by 1.

detail.name: Master Merchant
detail.description: Before making a check when buying or selling items, suffer 2 Strain to sell items for 25% more or buy for 25% less.

detail.name: Master of Shadows
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Stealth or Skulduggery check by 1.

detail.name: Master Pilot
detail.description: Once per round when piloting a vehicle using the Piloting: Space skill, suffer 2 Strain to perform any action as a maneuver instead.

detail.name: Master Slicer
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Computers or other slicing-related check by 1.

detail.name: Experienced Slicer
detail.description: Add :boost: to Computers and Skulduggery checks made by allies within Short range.

detail.name: Master Starhopper
detail.description: Once per round, suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Astrogation check by 1.

detail.name: Master Strategist
detail.description: Once per phase during a mass combat, may suffer 2 Strain to decrease the difficulty of a Mass Combat check once.

detail.name: Meditative Trance
detail.description: When suffocating, suffers 1 Strain each round instead of 3. When exposed to vacuum, suffers 1 Wound each round instead of 3.

detail.name: Mental Bond
detail.description: May commit :force: to communicate mentally with a bonded animal.

detail.name: Mental Fortress
detail.description: Spend one Destiny point to ignore effects of Critical Injuries on Intellect or Cunning checks until the end of the encounter.

detail.name: Mind Bleed
detail.description: If carrying items that total 2 Encumbrance or less, when targeted by an attack may suffer a number of Strain equal to the number of Wounds suffered from the attack to cause the attacker to suffer the same amount of Wounds.

detail.name: Mental Tools
detail.description: Always counts as having the right tools for the jobs when making Mechanics checks.

detail.name: Mind Over Matter
detail.description: May spend one Destiny point to recover {Willpower} Strain.

detail.name: Multiple Opponents
detail.description: Add :boost: to all Brawl, Melee, and Lightsaber combat checks when engaged with multiple opponents.

detail.name: Natural Blademaster
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Lightsaber or Melee check.

detail.name: Natural Brawler
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Brawl or Melee check.

detail.name: Natural Charmer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Charm or Deception check.

detail.name: Natural Commando
detail.description: Once per session, may re-roll one Ranged (Light) or Stealth check.

detail.name: Natural Doctor
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Medicine check.

detail.name: Natural Driver
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Piloting: Planetary or Gunnery check.

detail.name: Natural Enforcer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Coercion or Streetwise check.

detail.name: Natural Hunter
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Perception or Vigilance check.

detail.name: Natural Leader
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Cool or Leadership check.

detail.name: Natural Marksman
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Ranged: Light or Ranged: Heavy check.

detail.name: Natural Mystic
detail.description: Once per session, the character may reroll any one Force power check.

detail.name: Natural Negotiator
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Cool or Negotiation check.

detail.name: Natural Outdoorsman
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Resilience or Survival check.

detail.name: Natural Pilot
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Piloting: Space or Gunnery check.

detail.name: Natural Programmer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Comput­ers or Astrogation check.

detail.name: Natural Rogue
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Skulduggery or Stealth check.

detail.name: Natural Scholar
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Knowledge check.

detail.name: Natural Tinkerer
detail.description: Once per session, may reroll any one Mechanics check.

detail.name: Niman Technique
detail.description: May use Willpower instead of Brawn when making lightsaber checks.

detail.name: No Escape
detail.description: When making a Coercion check, may spend :advantage::advantage: to cause one enemy within Short range to lose their free maneuver during their next turn. When an enemy within Short range makes a Fear check, may spend :threat::threat: from that check to cause the enemy to lose their free maneuver during their next turn.

detail.name: Nobody’s Fool
detail.description: Upgrade difficulty of Charm, Coercion, and Deception checks targeting the character {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Now the Master
detail.description: Once per session, may choose one character in the encounter and one talent or Force power the target character possesses. For the remainder of the encounter the character counts as having that talent or Force power.

detail.name: Now You See Me
detail.description: Once per session, may make a :hard: Deception check to make {Cunning} NPCs within Medium range forget any interactions they had with the character during the last thirty minutes.

detail.name: Once a Learner
detail.description: As an action, may suffer 4 Strain to increase the Force rating of one ally within Short range by {Force Rating} until the end of the end of the character's next turn.

detail.name: One With the Universe
detail.description: Once per session, may spend several minutes meditating, then make an :average: Astrogation check to add :lightside: to all Force power checks. If the character succeeds with :threat:, add :darkside: instead.

detail.name: Outdoorsman
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from checks to move through terrain or manage environmental effects; reduce overland travel times by 50%.

detail.name: Overwhelm Defences
detail.description: After making an unsuccessful attack with a starship or vehicle weapon, may spend :advantage::advantage: per rank. Reduce the defence rating in the zone targeted by 1 for every :advantage::advantage: spent.

detail.name: Overwhelm Emotions
detail.description: When performing a Charm, Coercion, or Deception check, may add {Force Rating}. Spend :lightside: to add :success: to Charm checks; spend :darkside: to add :success: to Coercion or Deception checks. However, every :lightside::lightside: adds :failure: to Coercion or Deception checks while :darkside::darkside: adds :failure: to Charm checks.

detail.name: Parry
detail.description: When struck by a melee attack but before applying Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}.

detail.name: Parry (Improved)
detail.description: When struck by a melee attack but before applying Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}. When parrying a hit that generated :despair: or :threat::threat::threat:, may hit attacker once with a wielded Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber weapon dealing base damage, after the original attack is resolved.

detail.name: Improved Parry
detail.description: When struck by a melee attack but before applying Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}. When parrying a hit that generated :despair: or :threat::threat::threat:, may hit attacker once with a wielded Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber weapon dealing base damage, after the original attack is resolved.

detail.name: Parry (Supreme)
detail.description: When struck by a melee attack but before applying Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}. When parrying a hit that generated :despair: or :threat::threat::threat:, may hit attacker once with a wielded Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber weapon dealing base damage, after the original attack is resolved. If the character didn’t make a combat check during their previous turn, suffer 1 Strain instead of 3.

detail.name: Persistent Targeting
detail.description: After making a successful combat check against a target, add :boost: to all combat checks against the same target for the remainder of the encounter.

detail.name: Physical Training
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to Athletics and Resistance checks.

detail.name: Physician
detail.description: When this character makes a Medicine check to help a character heal wounds, the target heals {ranks} additional wounds.

detail.name: Pin
detail.description: As an action upon a successful opposed Athletics check against an Engaged opponent, immobilise that opponent until the end of the attacker’s next turn; may spend :triumph: on check to increase duration one round.

detail.name: Plausible Deniability
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Coercion and Deception checks.

detail.name: Plausible Deniability (Improved)
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Coercion and Deception checks. As an action, may make a :hard: Coercion check to convince {rank|words} uninvolved bystander NPC to leave the scene without asking questions.

detail.name: Point Blank
detail.description: Add {ranks} damage to all Ranged: Heavy and Ranged: Light attacks made at Short or Engaged range.

detail.name: Positive Spin
detail.description: When any character's Duty would increase by one or more, it increases by that amount plus {ranks} instead.

detail.name: Powerful Blast
detail.description: Increase Blast damage dealt by explosives, explosive weapons, and grenades by {ranks}.

detail.name: Precise Aim
detail.description: Once per round, may perform a Precise Aim maneuver to suffer up to {ranks} Strain to reduce target’s melee and ranged defences by Strain spent.

detail.name: Preemptive Avoidance
detail.description: Immediately after an opponent moves to engage the character, may spend a Destiny point to disengage from that opponent as an out of turn incidental.

detail.name: Pressure Point
detail.description: When making a Brawl check against a living opponent, may add {Medicine} to damage and deal damage as Strain instead of Wounds.

detail.name: Prey on the Weak
detail.description: Deal +{ranks} damage against Disoriented targets.

detail.name: Push the Limit
detail.description: As an incidental, suffer 2 system to add :boost: to Piloting: Planetary checks.

detail.name: Quick Draw
detail.description: Once per round, may draw or holster a weapon as an incidental.

detail.name: Quick Draw (Improved)
detail.description: Twice per round, may draw or holster a weapon as an incidental.

detail.name: Quick Fix
detail.description: Once per session, may make one skill check using Agility rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.

detail.name: Quick Movement
detail.description: Before making a non-Force power check, may suffer 2 Strain to add {Force Rating} to the check; spend :forcepip::forcepip: to perform one free Move maneuver after the check is finished.

detail.name: Quick Strike
detail.description: When performing a combat check, add {ranks|boost} against any target that has not yet acted in the encounter.

detail.name: Rain of Death
detail.description: Perform the Rain of Death maneuver to ignore the increased difficulty due to the Auto-Fire quality of attacks made this turn.

detail.name: Rapid Reaction
detail.description: May suffer 1 Strain to add :success: to any Vigilance or Cool check to determine initia­tive order.

detail.name: Rapid Recovery
detail.description: When recovering Strain at the end of the encounter recover {ranks} additional Strain.

detail.name: Ready for Anything
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from mass combat made while the character is acting on the side of the acting force and the character’s Cool or Vigilance checks to determine Initiative order.

detail.name: Reconstruct the Scene
detail.description: Once per session as an action, may make a :hard: Perception check at a crime scene to identify all prominent physical characteristics of one person who was at the scene in the last 24 hours per :success:.

detail.name: Redundant Systems
detail.description: Once per session, may make an :easy: MEchanics check to harvest components from a functioning device to repair a broken one, without breaking the functioning device.

detail.name: Reflect
detail.description: When struck by a ranged attack but before apply­ing Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}.

detail.name: Reflect (Improved)
detail.description: When struck by a ranged attack but before apply­ing Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}. When reflecting a hit that generated :despair: or :threat::threat::threat:, may hit one target within Medium range dealing the same damage as the initial attack, after the original attack is resolved.

detail.name: Improved Reflect
detail.description: When struck by a ranged attack but before applying Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}. When reflecting a hit that generated :despair: or :threat::threat::threat:, may hit one target within Medium range dealing the same damage as the initial attack, after the original attack is resolved.

detail.name: Reflect (Supreme)
detail.description: When struck by a ranged attack but before apply­ing Soak, suffer 3 Strain to reduce damage by {ranks|plus-2}. When reflecting a hit that generated :despair: or :threat::threat::threat:, may hit one target within Medium range dealing the same damage as the initial attack, after the original attack is resolved. If the character didn’t make a combat check during their previous turn, suffer 1 Strain instead of 3.

detail.name: Researcher
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Knowledge checks; researching a subject takes half the time.

detail.name: Researcher (Improved)
detail.description: On a successful Knowledge check, the character and allies receive :advantage::advantage: on future related checks, until the end of the character’s next turn.

detail.name: Resist Disarm
detail.description: May suffer 2 Strain to avoid being disarmed or having a weapon damaged or destroyed.

detail.name: Resolve
detail.description: When suffering Strain, reduce the amount suffered by {ranks}, to a minimum of 1.

detail.name: Respected Scholar
detail.description: Downgrade the difficulty of all checks to interact with institutions of learning {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Ritual Caster
detail.description: Must spend a maneuver before using any Force powers. In addition, may only use the Foresee power out­ doors and at night.

detail.name: Saber Swarm
detail.description: As a maneuver, suffer 1 Strain to gain Linked {Force Rating} on the next Lightsaber (Agility) combat check.

detail.name: Saber Throw
detail.description: Make a Lightsaber check against a target within Medium range, adding :force: up to Force rating: spend :forcepip: for attack to succeed and :forcepip: for lightsaber to return to hand.

detail.name: Sarlacc Sweep
detail.description: As an action, make a Lightsaber combat check with +1 difficulty against one engaged target; spend :advantage::advantage: to hit one additional engaged target.

detail.name: Savvy Negotiator
detail.description: May remove {ranks|setback} from all Negotiation and Streetwise checks.

detail.name: Scathing Tirade
detail.description: As an action, make an :average: Coercion check; each :success: causes one enemy in Short range to suffer 1 Strain. Spend :advantage: to cause 1 affected enemy to suffer 1 additional Strain.

detail.name: Scathing Tirade (Improved)
detail.description: As an action, make an :average: Coercion check; each :success: inflicts 1 Strain on a target in Short range. Spend :advantage: to inflict 1 additional Strain on one affected target; all affected targets suffer :setback: to all checks for {Coercion} rounds.

detail.name: Improved Scathing Tirade
detail.description: As an action, make an :average: Coercion check; each :success: inflicts 1 Strain on a target in Short range. Spend :advantage: to inflict 1 additional Strain on one affected target; all affected targets suffer :setback: to all checks for {Coercion} rounds.

detail.name: Scathing Tirade (Supreme)
detail.description: As an action, make an :average: Coercion check; each :success: inflicts 1 Strain on a target in Short range. Spend :advantage: to inflict 1 additional Strain on one affected target; all affected targets suffer :setback: to all checks for {Coercion} rounds. May suffer 1 Strain to perform Scathing Tirade as a maneuever.

detail.name: Second Chances
detail.description: Once per encounter, may choose {ranks|words} positive dice in one skill check and reroll them.

detail.name: Second Wind
detail.description: Once per encounter, may recover {ranks} Strain as an incidental.

detail.name: Selective Detonation
detail.description: When using a weapon with the Blast quality, spend :advantage: to exclude one target that would normally be affected by the explosion. Multiple targets may be excluded up to ranks in Selective Detonation.

detail.name: Sense Advantage
detail.description: Once per session, may add :setback::setback: to the skill check of one NPC within Extreme range.

detail.name: Sense Danger
detail.description: Once per session, remove :setback::setback: from any check.

detail.name: Sense Emotions
detail.description: Add :boost: to all Charm, Coercion, and Deception checks unless the target is immune to Force powers.

detail.name: Sense the Scene
detail.description: Once per session as an action, may make a :hard: Perception check at a crime scene, adding {ranks|Force Rating} to the roll. Spend :forcepip: to identify the emotional state of one person involved.

detail.name: Share Pain
detail.description: When a bonded animal suffers Wound, as an incidental, may reduce the Wounds suffered by half (rounded up) then suffer an equal number of Wounds.

detail.name: Shien Technique
detail.description: May use Cunning instead of Brawn when making Lightsaber skill checks.

detail.name: Shortcut
detail.description: During a chase, add {ranks|boost} to any checks made to catch or escape an opponent.

detail.name: Shortcut (Improved)
detail.description: During a chase, add {ranks|boost} to any checks made to catch or escape an opponent and may suffer 2 Strain to add {ranks|success} to the check.

detail.name: Shroud
detail.description: Once per session, may spend one Destiny point to become undetectable via the Force and to make own Force powers unnoticeable.

detail.name: Side Step
detail.description: As a maneuver may suffer up to {ranks} Strain to upgrade the difficulty of all ranged attacks targeting this character by 1 per Strain spent until the start of the character’s next turn.

detail.name: Signature Vehicle
detail.description: When in a starship or vehicle with functional coms, allies within Short range add :boost: to their Perception and Vigilance checks; allies within Close range add :boost::boost: instead.

detail.name: Sixth Sense
detail.description: The character gains +1 ranged defence.

detail.name: Skilled Jockey
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from all Pilot checks.

detail.name: Skilled Slicer
detail.description: When making a Computers check, may spend :triumph: to gain some measure of control over the target system. Further Computers checks within this system can be made as maneuvers.

detail.name: Skilled Teacher
detail.description: Before an ally at Short range makes a skill check, if that ally has fewer ranks in the skill than the character does, may, as an incidental, suffer up to {ranks} in Strain to add an equal number of :success: to the ally's next check.

detail.name: Sleight of Mind
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to Stealth checks unless the opposition is immune to Force powers.

detail.name: Slippery Minded
detail.description: On any turn in which the character is under the effects of a Force power, as an action, may make a :hard: Deception check to no longer be under the effects of the Force power.

detail.name: Smooth Talker (Charm)
detail.description: When making Charm checks, spend :triumph: to gain {ranks|success}.

detail.name: Smooth Talker (Coercion)
detail.description: When making Coercion checks, spend :triumph: to gain {ranks|success}.

detail.name: Smooth Talker (Deception)
detail.description: When making Deception checks, spend :triumph: to gain {ranks|success}.

detail.name: Smooth Talker (Negotiation)
detail.description: When making Negotiation checks, spend :triumph: to gain {ranks|success}.

detail.name: Sniper Shot
detail.description: Reduce difficulty of combat checks at Long or Extreme range by 1.

detail.name: Soft Spot
detail.description: After a successful attack with a non-starship/vehicle weapon, may spend a Destiny Point to add {Cunning} to damage for one hit.

detail.name: Solid Repairs
detail.description: When repairing Hull Trauma on a starship or vehicle, repair +{ranks} Hull Trauma.

detail.name: Soresu Technique
detail.description: May use Intellect instead of Brawn when making Lightsaber skill checks.

detail.name: Sound Investments
detail.description: Gain {ranks|multiply-100} credits at the beginning of each session.

detail.name: Spare Clip
detail.description: Does not run out of ammo on :despair:.

detail.name: Speaks Binary
detail.description: When directing NPC droids, may grant them {ranks|boost} of Speaks Binary on all skill checks.

detail.name: Spitfire
detail.description: After making a successful check with two Ranged: Light weapons, each additional hit generated as part of the attack can be allocated to any other target within range of the weapon.

detail.name: Stand Firm
detail.description: Once per encounter, the character may take the Stand Firm action, making a :hard: Leadership check. If the check is successful, the character chooses one ally within Medium range for each :success: on the check. Until the end of the encounter, chosen allies increase their wound threshold by an amount equal to the character's Presence rating. (Multiple uses of this talent are not cumulative).

detail.name: Starship Adversary
detail.description: Upgrade difficulty of all combat checks against a ship this character is commanding {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Stalker
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to all Coordination and Stealth checks.

detail.name: Steady Nerves
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from Cool or Skulduggery checks.

detail.name: Steely Nerves
detail.description: Spend one Destiny point to ignore effects of Critical Injuries on Willpower or Presence checks until the end of the encounter.

detail.name: Stim Application
detail.description: May make an :average: Medicine check to increase the characteristic of one Engaged ally by 1 for the remainder of the encounter and cause them to suffer 4 Strain.

detail.name: Stim Application (Improved)
detail.description: As an incidental, when performing the Stim Application action, may increase the difficulty to :hard: and reduce the Strain the target suffers to 1.

detail.name: Stim Application (Supreme)
detail.description: When performing the Stim Application action , each :triumph: causes an additional characteristic to be increased by one.

detail.name: Stimpack Specialisation
detail.description: Whenever the character uses a stimpack, the target heals {ranks} additional Wounds,

detail.name: Strategic Form
detail.description: While wielding a Lightsaber weapon, as a action, may make a :hard: Lightsaber (Intellect) check adding {Force Rating} to the dice pool. For each :success:, one target within Short range may only make combat checks targeting the character until the end of the following round. Spend :forcepip: to affeect a target for one additional round.

detail.name: Street Smarts
detail.description: Remove {ranks|setback} from any Knowledge: Underworld or Streetwise checks.

detail.name: Stroke of Genius
detail.description: Once per session, may substitute Intellect characteristic on a skill check.

detail.name: Strong Arm
detail.description: Treat thrown weapons as if they had one step greater in range, to a maximum of Medium range.

detail.name: Stunning Blow
detail.description: May inflict damage as Strain instead of Wounds; does not ignore Soak.

detail.name: Stunning Blow (Improved)
detail.description: May inflict damage as Strain instead of Wounds; may spend :triumph: on Brawl checks to stagger target for 1 round per :triumph:.

detail.name: Sum Djem
detail.description: When making a Lightsaber combat check, may spend :triumph: or :advantage::advantage: to disarm the opponent. The weapon lands anywhere within Short range.

detail.name: Sunder (Improved)
detail.description: Each :advantage: spent to activate a weapon's Sunder quality damages the item two steps instead of one.

detail.name: Superior Reflexes
detail.description: The character gains +1 melee defence.

detail.name: Surgeon
detail.description: When making a Medicine check to help a character heal wounds, the target heals {ranks} additional Wounds.

detail.name: Swift
detail.description: Do not suffer usual pen­alties for moving through difficult terrain.

detail.name: Tactical Combat Training
detail.description: Melee and Ranged: Heavy become career skills.

detail.name: Talk the Talk
detail.description: When making a Knowledge check, may spend one Destiny point to use Knowledge: Underworld or Streetwise for the required skill.

detail.name: Targeted Blow
detail.description: After making a successful attack, may spend a Destiny Point to add {Agility} to damage for one hit.

detail.name: Technical Aptitude
detail.description: Reduce the amount of time to complete computer-related tasks by 25% per rank.

detail.name: Terrify
detail.description: As an action, may make a :hard: Coercion check adding {Force Rating} to the dice pool. For each :success:, one target within Medium range is Disoriented until the end of the next round. Spend :advantage::advantage: to increase the duration for all affected targets by one round; spend :forcepip: to Immobilise an affected target.

detail.name: Terrify (Improved)
detail.description: As an action, may make an :average: Coercion check adding {Force Rating} to the dice pool. For each :success:, one target within Medium range is Disoriented until the end of the next round. Spend :advantage::advantage: to increase the duration for all affected targets by one round; spend :forcepip: to Immobilise an affected target; spend :triumph: to Stagger an affected target.

detail.name: The Force is My Ally
detail.description: Once per session may suffer 2 Strain to perform one Force power as a maneuver.

detail.name: Thorough Assessment
detail.description: Once per session as an action, make a :hard: Knowledge check to gain :boost: equal to :success: that can be distributed during the encounter.

detail.name: Time to Go
detail.description: Spend one Destiny point to perform a move maneuver as an incidental to attempt to move into cover or out of Blast range of a weapon or explosion.

detail.name: Time to Go (Improved)
detail.description: Spend one Destiny point to perform a move maneuver as an incidental to attempt to move into cover or out of Blast range of a weapon or explosion. One ally at Engaged ranged may all also make a Move maneuver as an incidental.

detail.name: Tinkerer
detail.description: Increase the number of hard points in {ranks|words} by one.

detail.name: Touch of Fate
detail.description: Once per session, may add :boost::boost: to any one skill check.

detail.name: Tricky Target
detail.description: Any vehicle the character pilots counts as having a Silhoutte one lower than normal when being attacked, to a minimum of 0.

detail.name: True Aim
detail.description: Once per round, may perform a True Aim maneuver to gain all the benefits of aiming and upgrade combat check {ranks|times}.

detail.name: Trust No One
detail.description: When targeted by a social check, may suffer 1 Strain to add :failure: to the check. If the check fails with :despair:, may immediately perform a maneuver as an out of turn incidental.

detail.name: Twisted Words
detail.description: When a social check targeting the character generates :threat::threat: or :despair:, may suffer 1 Strain as an incidental to inflict {Coercion} Strain on the character who made the check.

detail.name: Unarmed Parry
detail.description: May perform the Parry incidental when unarmed. Reduce the Strain cost when unarmed by 1 to a minimum of 1.

detail.name: Uncanny Reactions
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to all Vigilance checks.

detail.name: Uncanny Senses
detail.description: Add {ranks|boost} to all Perception checks.

detail.name: Unstoppable
detail.description: If the roll for a Critical Injury is a 1 or is reduced to 1 the character does not receive the Critical Injury.

detail.name: Up the Ante
detail.description: When gambling, win {ranks|multiply-10}% more credits.

detail.name: Utility Belt
detail.description: Spend one Destiny point to perform a Utility Belt incidental; produce a previously undocumented item or weapon (with restrictions) from a tool belt or a satchel.

detail.name: Utinni!
detail.description: The character removes {ranks|setback} from checks made to find or scavenge items or gear. These checks could include Negotiation, Perception, or other checks. Such skill checks take half their normal time.

detail.name: Valuable Facts
detail.description: Make an :average: Knowledge check. If successful, add :triumph: to one ally’s skill check during the encounter.

detail.name: Vehicle Combat Training
detail.description: Gunnery and Piloting: Planetary become career skills.

detail.name: Walk the Walk
detail.description: May spend one Destiny point to add {Streetwise} damage to one hit of a successful Brawl check.

detail.name: Well Rounded
detail.description: The character may choose two skills to become career skills.

detail.name: Well Travelled
detail.description: Knowledge: Core Worlds and Knowledge: Outer Rim become career skills.

detail.name: Wheel and Deal
detail.description: When selling goods legally, gain {ranks|multiply-10}% more credits.

detail.name: Wise Warrior
detail.description: Once per round when making a combat check as an incidental, may spend one Destiny point to use any characteristic for the check.

detail.name: Wise Warrior (Improved)
detail.description: Once per round when making a combat check as an incidental, may spend one Destiny point to allow the character and one ally at Short range to use any characteristic for the check.

detail.name: Works Like a Charm
detail.description: Once per session, the character may make one skill check using Presence, rather than the characteristic linked to that skill.
